verdict.rationale: Token2's fido2-manage is documented as command-line tools with an optional GUI on top. Its CLI covers passkey, PIN, biometric, SSH key and export operations, so the CLI appears to match that GUI. There is no documented API: OpenAPI probes all 404. Nothing shows programmatic parity for the all-in-one Companion App's PIV/OTP functions. missing for 10: a documented API (REST/SDK), explicit UI-to-API parity statement, programmatic coverage of Companion App PIV/OTP features, independent corroboration.
